variants: 新品未開封|未開封品|シュリンク付き
meaning_en: Factory sealed. Highest collector grade for figures and kuji prizes.

variants: 開封済み|開封のみ|開封品
meaning_en: Box was opened; item typically displayed or inspected. Usually still complete.

variants: 箱無し|外箱なし|本体のみ
meaning_en: Original packaging missing. Fine for display; lowers resale value noticeably.

variants: 箱に傷|箱ダメージ|箱イタミ
meaning_en: Packaging dented or scuffed; item itself usually unaffected.

variants: 難有り|訳あり|ワケあり
meaning_en: Seller declares a defect. Ask what exactly is wrong before buying.
risk_flag: Ask seller for photos of the defect

meaning_en: Sold without guarantee of function or completeness. Parts may be missing.
Generic secondhand label. Says nothing about grade by itself.
Original release from the period rather than a re-release. Can raise value for older lines.
A later production run. Usually cheaper than original run; check which run the listing is.

variants: プライズ品|クレーンゲーム景品
meaning_en: Arcade/crane-game item. Lower MSRP tier than scale figures; not a defect.
Seller asserts authenticity. Not proof by itself.
risk_flag: Verify maker name and packaging text

meaning_en: May be a legitimate regional release or a bootleg. Needs verification.
risk_flag: Check maker and JAN against catalog

meaning_en: No manufacturer stated. Strong bootleg indicator for character goods.

variants: まとめ売り|まとめ|セット売り
meaning_en: Multiple items sold together. Resolve each item separately if possible.
Bundle only; cannot buy a single item from the lot.
